description: The Freeman P14G50FECR 14-gauge 50-foot retractable extension cord reel features an automatic guide retraction system to smoothly retract the extension cord and prevent tangles and knots, making it ideal for amateurs and professionals looking for a better storage solution. Pull the extension cord out to desired length and the continuous locking mechanism locks the cord at 18" intervals. When you're done, give the cord a short pull to gently retract. This 14 gauge 50 foot heavy duty extension cord has triple grounded output capability, and an integrated circuit breaker with reset button protects against blown switches and fuses. Mount the lightweight, compact reel to your garage or workshop wall with the included 180-degree swivel mount to free up workspace and prevent the cord from becoming a tripping hazard. The 50 foot 14 gauge retractable extension cord reel is designed for maximum efficiency and ease of use, and is covered by the professional 1-year warranty of Freeman.
